_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Saying yes when you really mean no

segments.text: It means, it is a soft no.
Do you like coffee? Not really.

native.caption: ノーと言いにくくて、つい「Yes」と答えていませんか？“Not really.”なら、やんわり断れる自然な言い方です。例：“Do you like coffee?” “Not really.” Carlos先生のあとに続けて言ってみよう。Lexkiteアプリで練習。

en.hook: How do you say "not really" in English?
en.caption: Is it hard to say no, so you answer “Yes”? “Not really.” is a natural, soft way to say no. Example: “Do you like coffee?” “Not really.” Repeat after teacher Carlos. Practice in the Lexkite app.
